description: This file defines a singleton client for interacting with the Supabase backend in the SpendSense frontend. It manages environment variable configuration, provides diagnostic functions, and exports the client instance and related utilities.

methods.name: getSupabaseDiagnostics
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current Supabase environment configuration for debugging, including presence of URL and key, and a key suffix.

methods.name: isSupabaseConfiguredFn
methods.description: Checks if Supabase is configured based on environment variables.

methods.name: getSupabase
methods.description: Returns the singleton Supabase client instance or null if not configured.
